steps.name: fetch ifs 12 UTC 2 m temperature (heat wave)
fetch aifs 12 UTC 2 m temperature (heat wave)
fetch gfs 12 UTC 2 m temperature (heat wave)
verify 3 earlier forecasts against the IFS analysis; update online weights (B4)

notes: Live run: IFS, AIFS, GFS 00 UTC forecasts, averaged onto the 1.5° training grid.

Weights start from learned training skill (IFS <- HRES, AIFS <- GraphCast) and move toward each model's own live record as days are verified (B4, ~20-day memory; each model's mean error against the analysis is removed first, so only its random error shapes the weights). GFS has no training counterpart: it starts from HRES skill with 1.5x the error, so it carries little weight until its own verified days accumulate.
Verified days behind today's weights (mean over cells and leads): t2m 0.7, wind 0.7, mslp 0.7. Rain has no live truth: training prior only.
Live truth is the IFS analysis (step 0), which favours IFS; hindcast scorecards use ERA5 / CHIRPS.
Bias correction: IFS uses the HRES seasonal bias; the other models are not bias-corrected.
Rain weights over the sea are equal (rain truth is land only, so there is no learned skill there).
Extremes: each live model votes at its training counterpart's quantile threshold; calibrated on training years for the IFS/AIFS pair.

Regime of the init day: Normal (same rules and ERA5 2003-2017 climatology as the hindcasts; live proxies: yesterday's Day-1 blended rain and afternoon temperature, today's IFS analysis pressure; z-scores cmz_rain -0.6, nw_rain +1.8, heat_t2m -0.1, bay_mslp_min +0.6). Weights do not depend on it: regime weights gave no held-out gain. Not available yet: cmz_rain (3 days) (needs earlier live runs), so those rules could not fire.
Live verification t2m (RMSE °C, Day 1, 4 day(s) vs IFS analysis): blend 0.95, ifs 0.66, aifs 0.99, gfs 1.70.
Live verification wind (RMSE m/s, Day 1, 4 day(s) vs IFS analysis): blend 0.57, ifs 0.59, aifs 0.53, gfs 1.05.
Live verification mslp (RMSE hPa, Day 1, 4 day(s) vs IFS analysis): blend 0.59, ifs 0.53, aifs 0.64, gfs 1.62.

extremes.name: Very strong wind (top 1 %)
extremes.threshold: 10 m wind above the cell's 99th percentile (training years)

extremes.threshold: 24 h rain above the cell's 95th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Very heavy rain (top 1 %)
extremes.threshold: 24 h rain above the cell's 99th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Rain ≥ 25 mm
extremes.threshold: 24 h rain ≥ 25 mm averaged over the grid cell

extremes.name: Heat wave (IMD rule)
extremes.threshold: IMD heat-wave rule on 12 UTC 2 m temperature, 2 consecutive days
extremes.note: IMD rule applied per 1.5° cell to 12 UTC (17:30 IST) 2 m temperature; normal = ERA5 1990-2019 12 UTC climatology; hills = orography >= 1000 m, coast = cells touching the sea; stations -> cells. A cell mean at 17:30 IST runs below station Tmax, so absolute thresholds trigger less often than at stations. Probability = temperature weights of the models meeting the rule; uncalibrated. Models: IFS, AIFS, GFS. Day 1 is checked against yesterday's afternoon from the previous live run.
